raw_text: The Indian Army on Saturday categorically denied a viral drone video that claimed to show its soldiers crossing the Line of Control. Defence sources said the footage was a 'spliced fabrication' combining stock terrain imagery with digitally inserted figures. Independent metadata analysis confirmed the video's origins from commercial stock footage libraries. The incident highlights the growing threat of manipulated media in information warfare along the India-Pakistan border.
clean_text: Indian Army denied viral drone video claiming to show soldiers crossing LoC. Defence sources confirmed footage was spliced fabrication using stock imagery with digitally inserted figures.
